messages:
alex: Heads-up — release/2026.03 CI just flaked during artifact upload, looks like the shared cache hit a throttle and multiple workers timed out. Canary promos are blocked right now.

maya: seeing same in the runner logs, upload retries getting 503s from blobstore. full log snippet: 
```
[worker-12] PUT /v1/artifacts/chunk -- 503 ServiceUnavailable
retry 1/3
[worker-14] upload chunk failed: throttled by quota
```

jamal: CI metrics show sudden spike in concurrent uploads around 10:11 UTC, likely the cache storm from parallel builds. Rate limiter on the storage tier started rejecting. Can confirm capacity is the issue, not checksum.

ci-bot: build #17241: artifact upload failed after 3 retries (exit_code=1). Triggering auto-retry in 2m.

alex: auto-retry didn't help. We need a short unblock plan: either pin canary to last-known-good image, or rebuild with serialized artifact uploads (lower parallelism). Thoughts?

maya: quick options: 1) pin to `release-2026.03-rc1` which passed earlier and promotes fast, 2) kick a rebuild with `--concurrency=2` to avoid hitting the quota, or 3) ask infra to temporarily raise blobstore quota for the change window. Raising quota will take >30m.

jamal: pinning is safest to meet SLA for the demo at 11:00. We should still run a low-parallel rebuild in the background to verify new artifacts and then swap if green.

sophie: Product asks to avoid rollback unless necessary. Demo relies on canary being up. Pin + background rebuild sounds best. Please add release note that we pinned and will follow up.

alex: agreed. Action list:
- maya: run `deploy-bot promote --tag release-2026.03-rc1 --to canary --reason "artifact upload throttle"` now.
- maya: start low-parallel rebuild `ci/build.sh --concurrency=2` and watch artifact upload.
- jamal: open incident for blobstore quota spike and coordinate with cloud infra for postmortem.
- alex: I'll update release notes and changelog.

maya: promoting now. deploy-bot next.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued: tag=release-2026.03-rc1 -> canary by maya at 3529998888.

ci-bot: background rebuild queued with concurrency=2 (job id 17242).

jamal: incident created: INC-2026-148. Adding heap of metrics and request traces.

maya: manual verify started against canary endpoints, smoke OK so far. :eyes:

alex: releasing note drafted: "Temporary pin to release-2026.03-rc1 due to artifact upload throttling; full rebuild in progress and will promote if green." I'll paste the note into release checklist after this thread.

ci-bot: job 17242 completed: all artifacts uploaded successfully under serialized mode, integration smoke passed.

maya: rebuilt image hash: sha256:abcd1234. If we want to swap, we should do a canary replace with `deploy-bot replace --canary --image sha256:abcd1234` during the change window (now).

alex: plan: keep pinned canary for now until product confirms demo stability at 11:00. If green, schedule a controlled swap at 11:15 with small traffic ramp. If anything flips, we'll rollback to rc1.

sophie: demo confirmed stable. Please proceed with swap at 11:15. Add a note if swap fails.

maya: scheduling swap at 11:15 and will run gradual ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 5m holds and health checks.

deploy-bot: replace started: canary -> image sha256:abcd1234. ramping to 10%.

jamal: monitoring: latency and error budgets look fine at 10% stage.

deploy-bot: ramp at 50%. healthchecks passing.

deploy-bot: ramp to 100%. Promotion complete.

alex: closing this thread. Follow-up: jamal to lead postmortem, maya to file infra ticket for quota increase or adaptive client backoff in uploader, ci team to add serialized fallback when upload errors exceed X.

jamal: filing postmortem now and will include timelines + mitigation.

sophie: thanks team :thumbsup:
